points.point: Does an Instagram post automatically show on Facebook Page
points.sentence: Blotato's Instagram publisher submits to Instagram.

points.point: Will selecting both Instagram and Facebook cause people to see it twice (duplicates)
points.sentence: If Instagram's native crossposting is enabled, check Facebook before sending an additional Facebook post to avoid duplicates.

verdict.reason: The entry states Blotato's Instagram publisher submits only to Instagram and warns about duplicates when Instagram's native crossposting is on and Facebook is also posted to.
